comparisonNotes: Initial parent-billing-portal experiment invalid: shared node_modules junction caused Vite font allow-list errors. Stopped its owned process tree. This run is not product regression evidence.
Clean comparison uses separate npm ci on parent, identical local-only environment variables, local database reset and owned Vite server per run.

Identical external observer captures request timings, route, worker/parallel slot, hashed fixture identity, console/page errors and final auth/bootstrap DOM markers; it does not intercept or modify requests.

Initial parent-clean startup attempts invalid: NODE_OPTIONS Windows backslashes were interpreted as escapes. No browser results were produced. Runner was stopped; the observer path now uses forward slashes and passed a standalone browser self-check before the observed comparison.

Parent coach-seat run additionally failed unapproved provider quantity preserves approved capacity in manual review at the same local Auth HTTP 504 boundary; this is a new observed failure, absent from the original 26-title list. Active-team, pending-team and compatible-upgrade total-deadline failures remain UNKNOWN pending comparison.
